title: Roman Numerals
description: Write a Zig program that converts an Arabic number (e.g., 1984) to Roman numerals.
hints: Use parallel arrays for values and their corresponding Roman numeral symbols
Iterate from largest to smallest value, greedily subtracting from the input number
Zig's `for (arr1, arr2) |a, b|` iterates two arrays in parallel
